decisions.reason: As a drainage housing platform tied to the firm's engineering-based system business, it is still more useful to retain than to withdraw unless it is replaced by a successor line.
Floor-level shower drainage remains at the center of the firm's accessible, low-profile bathroom strategy, so discontinuation within a year is unlikely.
The designer shower drainage range is closely aligned with the firm's flagship design-and-function positioning and would typically stay in the portfolio for several more years.
An integrated sloped shower element supports easier installation and renovation projects, which fits the firm's offer well enough to justify keeping it.

The backflow-protected basement drain is more niche than the core shower lines, but it solves a clear technical problem and supports the firm's specialist reputation, so retention is still slightly more likely than withdrawal.
